skills.name: koredocs
skills.selection_description: Use KoreDocs document, spreadsheet, and diagram capabilities.

tools.name: koredocs_diag_create
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: diagram create.

folder_path.description: Folder path in the shared KoreDocs/datauser tree, such as "/" or "/Projects". Missing folders are created.

name.description: Filename, with or without the .korediag extension.

diagram.description: Optional partial or complete diagram object.

tools.name: koredocs_diag_spec_get
tools.purpose: Return a comprehensive description of the .korediag JSON format specification.

tools.name: koredocs_doc_create
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: document create.

folder_path.description: Folder path in the shared KoreDocs/datauser tree, such as "/" or "/Projects". Missing folders are created.

name.description: Filename, with or without the .koredoc extension.

tools.name: koredocs_doc_create_from_scratchpad
tools.purpose: Create a KoreDoc from an exact prior tool result held in the scratchpad.

folder_path.description: Folder path for the new KoreDoc.

name.description: Filename, with or without the .koredoc extension.

scratchpad_content.description: Pass the exact token {scratchpad:key} shown after a prior tool result. KoreAgent resolves it before this tool runs, preserving generated text without model transcription.

title.description: Optional title stored in the embedded KoreDocs JSON header.

tags.description: Optional tags stored in the embedded KoreDocs JSON header.

tools.name: koredocs_doc_markdown_append
tools.purpose: Append markdown to the end of a .koredoc document.

markdown.description: Markdown block to append to the end of the document.

expected_revision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency check. When provided, the document must still be at this revision.

tools.name: koredocs_doc_outline_get
tools.purpose: Return the heading outline for a .koredoc document.

tools.name: koredocs_doc_section_insert
tools.purpose: Insert a markdown block into a .koredoc document by section anchor.

markdown.description: Markdown block to insert. Typically starts with a heading line.

parent_heading_path.description: Insert inside this parent section when after_heading_path is omitted.

insert_at_start.description: When parent_heading_path is used, insert immediately after the parent heading instead of at the end of the parent section.

expected_revision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency check. When provided, the document must still be at this revision.

tools.name: koredocs_doc_section_read
tools.purpose: Read a full .koredoc document, one heading section, or an explicit line range.

start_line.description: Optional 1-based start line for direct line-range reads.

end_line.description: Optional 1-based end line for direct line-range reads.

tools.name: koredocs_doc_section_replace
tools.purpose: Replace one heading section inside a .koredoc document.

heading_path.description: Heading path identifying the section to replace.

markdown.description: Complete replacement markdown for the section, including the heading line.

expected_revision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency check. When provided, the document must still be at this revision.

tools.name: koredocs_file_create
tools.purpose: Create a file in the KoreDocs file tree.

folder_path.description: Folder path in the shared KoreDocs/datauser tree, such as "/" or "/Projects". Missing folders are created.

tools.name: koredocs_file_delete
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: file delete.

tools.name: koredocs_file_format_get
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: file format get.

type.description: Document type: koredoc, koresheet, or korediag.

tools.name: koredocs_file_get
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: file get.

tools.name: koredocs_file_history_get
tools.purpose: Retrieve a historical artefact snapshot, including content and metadata.

tools.name: koredocs_file_history_list
tools.purpose: List immutable content-and-metadata revisions for an artefact.

tools.name: koredocs_file_update
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: file update.

metadata_patch.description: Optional deep merge patch for existing metadata.

tools.name: koredocs_files_list
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: files list.

tools.name: koredocs_files_metadata_search
tools.purpose: Search artefacts using structured metadata rather than filename or body words.

tools.name: koredocs_files_search
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: files search.

query.description: Search query. Supports words and quoted phrases.

folder_path.description: Optional folder path such as "/" or "/01-misc".

limit.description: Maximum number of results, between 1 and 200.

tools.name: koredocs_folder_create
tools.purpose: Create a folder in the KoreDocs file tree and return the resulting folder record.

path.description: Folder path in the shared KoreDocs/datauser tree, such as "/Projects/Calcs". Missing parents are created automatically.

tools.name: koredocs_folder_structure_get
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: folder structure get.

tools.name: koredocs_folders_list
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: folders list.

tools.name: koredocs_metadata_find_variants
tools.purpose: Find metadata field names that are close to a requested name, to expose naming drift.

field_name.description: Field name or dotted field path to compare, for example artefact_type.

folder_path.description: Optional folder path to limit the search.

tools.name: koredocs_metadata_inventory
tools.purpose: Inventory embedded KoreDoc metadata keys, values, counts, and example files.

folder_path.description: Optional folder path to limit the inventory.

max_examples.description: Maximum example documents returned for each metadata path.

tools.name: koredocs_metadata_rename_field
tools.purpose: Rename one exact top-level metadata field while preserving content and unrelated metadata.

old_field.description: Exact top-level metadata field to rename.

folder_path.description: Optional folder path to limit the migration.

apply_changes.description: False returns a dry run. True performs the listed exact changes.

tools.name: koredocs_metadata_replace_value
tools.purpose: Replace one exact top-level metadata value while preserving content and unrelated metadata.

field_name.description: Exact top-level metadata field whose value will be replaced.

folder_path.description: Optional folder path to limit the migration.

apply_changes.description: False returns a dry run. True performs the listed exact changes.

tools.name: koredocs_search
tools.purpose: Search the full text of KoreDocs files.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_cells_write
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: spreadsheet cells write.

cells.description: Sparse cell updates keyed by A1 address.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_column_find
tools.purpose: Locate a sheet column by header name.

header_row.description: Optional header row. When omitted, KoreDocs will guess a likely header row.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_create
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: spreadsheet create.

folder_path.description: Folder path in the shared KoreDocs/datauser tree, such as "/" or "/Projects". Missing folders are created.

name.description: Filename, with or without the .koresheet extension.

cells.description: Sparse cell map keyed by A1 address.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_describe
tools.purpose: Return a structural summary of a sheet, including guessed headers, sample rows, labels, and formulas.

sample_rows.description: Maximum number of table rows to preview.

header_row.description: Optional header row. When omitted, KoreDocs will guess a likely header row.

range_ref.description: Optional A1-style range constraining the structural description.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_get
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: spreadsheet get.

include_cells.description: When true, include the sparse cell map in the response.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_headers_get
tools.purpose: Return the detected column headers for a sheet, with an optional guessed header row.

header_row.description: Optional header row. When omitted, KoreDocs will guess a likely header row.

range_ref.description: Optional A1-style range constraining the header scan.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_headers_set
tools.purpose: Write or replace a contiguous header row.

headers.description: Header names to write into the sheet.

header_row.description: Row number where the headers should be written.

start_col.description: Starting column for the first header.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_labels_find
tools.purpose: Find labelled cells and return adjacent right/below values for navigation.

labels.description: Optional list of labels to search for. Omit to list likely label cells across the sheet.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_named_value_get
tools.purpose: Read a value cell next to a labelled cell.

label.description: Label to search for, such as "Interest Rate" or "Starting Balance".

direction.description: Which neighboring cell should be treated as the value cell.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_named_value_set
tools.purpose: Write a value cell next to a labelled cell.

label.description: Label to search for, such as "Interest Rate" or "Starting Balance".

value.description: New value to write into the neighboring value cell.

direction.description: Which neighboring cell should be treated as the value cell.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_preview
tools.purpose: Return a compact preview of a sheet as header-keyed rows.

sample_rows.description: Maximum number of table rows to preview.

header_row.description: Optional header row. When omitted, KoreDocs will guess a likely header row.

range_ref.description: Optional A1-style range constraining the preview.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_range_clear
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: spreadsheet range clear.

range.description: A1-style range such as B2:D9, A:A, or 3:3.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_range_read
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: spreadsheet range read.

range.description: A1-style range such as A1:C10, A:A, or 2:4.

values_only.description: When true, return scalar values instead of full cell objects.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_rows_append
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: spreadsheet rows append.

start_col.description: Start column for list-style rows. Defaults to A.

header_row.description: Header row to use when rows are objects keyed by column names.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_rows_find
tools.purpose: Find table rows by header-keyed filters.

filters.description: Header-keyed filters. Values may be scalars or objects like {contains: "foo"} or {gte: 10}.

header_row.description: Optional header row. When omitted, KoreDocs will guess a likely header row.

range_ref.description: Optional A1-style range constraining the search.

match_mode.description: Whether all filters must match or any filter may match.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_rows_update
tools.purpose: Update all matched table rows using header-keyed values.

updates.description: Header-keyed values to write into each matched row.

header_row.description: Optional header row. When omitted, KoreDocs will guess a likely header row.

range_ref.description: Optional A1-style range constraining the search.

match_mode.description: Whether all filters must match or any filter may match.

create_missing_columns.description: When true, create columns for any missing update headers.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_rows_upsert
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: spreadsheet rows upsert.

rows.description: Header-keyed rows to update or append.

key_columns.description: Header names that uniquely identify an existing row.

create_missing_columns.description: When true, create any missing header columns before writing.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_table_create
tools.purpose: Create a spreadsheet from headers plus initial rows, using table semantics instead of raw cells.

folder_path.description: Folder path in the shared KoreDocs/datauser tree, such as "/Projects/Calcs". Missing folders are created.

name.description: Filename, with or without the .koresheet extension.

rows.description: Optional initial rows. Each row may be a list of values or an object keyed by header names.

header_row.description: Row number where the headers should be written.

start_col.description: Starting column for the first header.

title.description: Optional sheet title. Defaults to the filename stem.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_table_read
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: spreadsheet table read.

range_ref.description: Optional A1-style range constraining the table view.

tools.name: koredocs_sheet_table_rows_append
tools.purpose: Append rows using a table-first interface rather than raw cell addresses.

rows.description: Rows to append. Each row may be a list of values or an object keyed by header names.

header_row.description: Optional header row. When omitted, KoreDocs will guess a likely header row.

create_missing_columns.description: When true, create any missing columns referenced by object-style rows.

tools.name: koredocs_types_list
tools.purpose: KoreDocs: types list.
